reviews.comment:
Pague con la APP YPF la nafta y sin drama. Cuando voy a pagar los Cafés de la misma manera ocurrió un error tres veces rechazándome el pago.
Resulta ser que aqui no podes usar la app dos veces, si pagaste una no podes usar para otra y viceversa.

(Translated by Google)
I paid for gas with the YPF app without any problems. However, when I tried to pay for coffee the same way, it failed three times, rejecting my payment.
It turns out you can't use the app twice here; if you've paid once, you can't use it again, and vice versa.
